This device uses the '''ShareWave''' (later bought out by '''Cirrus Logic''') Bodega chipset. The cards support 802.11b and ShareWave's proprietary Whitecap2 protocol. This card's PCMCIA device strings in Windows are.. *PCMCIA\Cirrus-Whitecap2-C12D *PCMCIA\Cirrus-Whitecap2-0254-0000 The [http://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/ShareWave/Bodega/WP222M_Driver&Utility_USA_36.zip WP222M drivers for Windows] do not work properly with this card. ==Images== [[Image:PESI_sharewave_wc2_unlabeled_pcb_top.jpg|thumb|none|600px|PCB top]]
